name: @ravian0772/jenkins-mcp
description: Connect AI assistants to any Jenkins CI/CD server. List jobs, trigger parameterised builds, check build status, fetch console logs, and inspect job metadata — all from natural language without leaving your editor.

scripts.build: tsc && chmod 755 build/index.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='build/index.js';fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))"
